skill.name: artifacts-builder
skill.description: Create complex Claude artifact projects with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui, then bundle them into a single HTML file.
skill.summary: Build and bundle multi-component React artifacts for Claude workflows.
skill.author: ComposioHQ

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign matches caused by Markdown formatting, shell-script scaffolding, local TypeScript config edits, documentation links, and reviewed component archive metadata. The remaining security concern is that this community skill intentionally installs npm and pnpm dependencies and may modify the local tool environment during project setup.

remediation.issue: Package manager commands install external dependencies during setup and bundling.
remediation.suggestion: Pin all dependency versions, document registry access, and ask users to review installs before running the scripts.

remediation.issue: The setup script may install pnpm globally when it is missing.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer Corepack or a local project-managed package manager path instead of changing the global environment.

remediation.issue: Component sources are distributed inside a compressed archive.
remediation.suggestion: Ship the component files as normal source files or include a manifest with checksums for easier marketplace review.

semantic_findings.title: Package Manager Installs External Dependencies
semantic_findings.description: The setup and bundling scripts run npm and pnpm commands that install packages from configured registries. This is expected for scaffolding but creates supply-chain and local environment risk for community use.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The package manager commands are explicit in the scripts, including a global pnpm install path and multiple dependency installs. The risk is supply-chain exposure and environment mutation, not clear malicious intent.

content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts need more structure than a single HTML file. This skill scaffolds a React project and bundles it into one shareable artifact.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18 TypeScript project through a setup script.
Configures Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui theme settings.
Adds local path aliases for imports from the source directory.
Installs Radix UI and shadcn/ui component dependencies.
Bundles a Vite app into one self-contained HTML file.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and package manager access.
Installs dependencies from configured npm and pnpm registries.
Best suited for complex artifacts, not simple static snippets.
Scripts modify files inside the generated project directory.

best_practices: Run setup in a new project directory with no unrelated files.
Review dependency installs before running community scripts.
Bundle only after the React app works correctly in development.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for a simple static HTML snippet.
Running setup from a directory that contains unrelated work.
Sharing the bundled artifact without reviewing behavior and dependencies.

faq.question: Does this skill create simple HTML snippets?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for multi-component React artifacts that need tooling, dependencies, and bundling.

faq.question: Which tools does it target?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows that can run local scripts.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts use npm and pnpm to install frontend and bundling packages.

faq.question: What does the final output look like?
faq.answer: The bundler creates one HTML file that contains the built app and inlined assets.

faq.question: Can I use shadcn/ui components?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup includes many shadcn/ui component sources and required Radix dependencies.

faq.question: What should I check before sharing?
faq.answer: Review the generated UI, installed dependencies, and bundled behavior before sharing the artifact.
